releaseNotes.text: New border-radius tokens have been introduced for various border-radius values. These tokens are accompanied by new visual updates made to input components such as TextInput, NumberInput, Search and more. Updates include rounded corners, a new gradient border, and some added margins and insets for surrounding buttons and menus.

A new preview DatePicker has been added to @carbon/react as preview__DatePicker. It is built on the Temporal API and a framework-agnostic state machine shared with @carbon/web-components, replacing the Flatpickr-based implementation. Stories and documentation can be found in the Components/Preview/preview__DatePicker section of Storybook.
The preview namespace exports DatePicker, DatePickerInput, and DatePickerSkeleton under preview__DatePicker. Migrating is largely an import change — see the migration guide . Flatpickr-specific props on the v11 DatePicker (appendTo, enable, parseDate, etc.) are now deprecated and will be removed in the next major release.
We'd like feedback on github or any of the #carbon-* channels on Slack on the following:
API and prop surface
Behavioral differences from the Flatpickr-backed component
Accessibility concerns
Any blockers, issues, etc.

Initial motion API has been added to @carbon/motion and @carbon/react packages. Stories along with documentation in the Overview page can be viewed in the Elements/Motion section of Storybook. The initial work covers definition of "surfaces" which are different motion animations we want to standardize (currently examples!) and new React wrapper components that implement the Motion library under the hood. There is an option to also utilize native CSS for the "reveal" surfaces.
In terms of accessibility, if use-prefer-reduced-motion is detected, the motion API will fallback to the current behavior in Carbon motion. Exploration of motion accessibility was done and captured in issue #22686.
We'd like feedback in #carbon-collective channel on Slack on the following:
Design concerns
Accessibility concerns
Developer ergonomics/api

notes.text: Initial motion API has been added to @carbon/motion and @carbon/react packages. Stories along with documentation in the Overview page can be viewed in the Elements/Motion section of Storybook. The initial work covers definition of "surfaces" which are different motion animations we want to standardize (currently examples!) and new React wrapper components that implement the Motion library under the hood. There is an option to also utilize native CSS for the "reveal" surfaces.

notes.text: A new preview DatePicker has been added to @carbon/react as preview__DatePicker. It is built on the Temporal API and a framework-agnostic state machine shared with @carbon/web-components, replacing the Flatpickr-based implementation. Stories and documentation can be found in the Components/Preview/preview__DatePicker section of Storybook.
